correction.incorrect_scope_claim: The inputs paragraph said no Eio resource/channel/store capability was captured by all five closures. That literal closure-environment claim was too broad at30b63a25.
correction.reason: The unread lambda projected checkpoint.messages inside its body, so checkpoint was a source-level free variable. Checkpoint.t also holds Context.t; Context implementation contains a mutable Hashtbl and a Stdlib/Eio mutex. The Range computation did not use that context, but computational purity is not proof that the wider closure environment excludes it.
correction.correct_old_head_reading: Old Range work reads messages only; there is no observed context access, data race or new I/O from it. Actual compiled closure layout and whether optimization already projected the field were not inspected. The claimed complete absence of extra captured capabilities was unsupported.

superseded_packaging_record.scope: That preserved report binds only8ae8b65a/f63f9359 and must not be used as a final verdict for the amended stack. This addendum corrects its reused source claim.

bounded_source_delta.exact_change: Project immutable checkpoint.messages before constructing the CPU closure and pass ~messages inside it. No other source/MLI delta from8ae8b65a. Other four closures already use message aliases.
bounded_source_delta.assessment: Field projection is a pure immutable-record read. R.unread_turns receives the same message value and other arguments in both inline and pooled modes; digest ordering, exceptions, extent/prefilters, source/Memory/cursor authority and worker cancellation policy are untouched. The unread lambda no longer lexically references checkpoint.
bounded_source_delta.retention_boundary: This is source-level capture narrowing only. It does not prove a particular compiled closure layout, that the caller releases checkpoint at a given phase, earlier collection, retained-heap reduction, RSS/peak memory or latency.

fresh_proof.compile_and_link: Full same-basename MLI then ML, complete helper and selected test compile; real C stub compile; explicit link targets fresh r3 CMX/object files. Existing actual include/dependency graph, fatal4/8/32/69, no -impl or warning suppression.
fresh_proof.matrix: Same four maintained scenarios in no-pool/caller-one-worker/nested-one-worker contexts; all12OK and terminal12tests run.
fresh_proof.scope: Fresh typecheck/link/selected behavior evidence against compatible prebuilt dependencies. Not full Consumer regression, cancellation/purge/replacement/real process restart, actual Memory settlement, provider/runtime/deployment proof or performance measurement. Native test durations are not a benchmark.
